jobs.title: Internal Investigator
jobs.description_text:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

The Internal Investigator is responsible for conducting timely, objective, and thorough investigations into employee theft, fraud, dishonesty, policy violations, and other internal-risk matters across ALO stores and operational locations. Reporting to the Internal Investigations Manager, this role will analyze exception-based reporting and operational intelligence into defensible investigations; conduct employee interviews; preserve evidence; document findings; and partner with Asset Protection, Human Resources, Legal, Retail Operations, and law enforcement as appropriate. 

The successful candidate combines strong analytical judgment with disciplined investigative interviewing, clear writing, discretion, and the ability to manage sensitive matters in a fast-moving retail environment.

jobs.title: Sr. Account Executive, Retail Media
jobs.description_text: Help retailers turn shopper intent into a growing media business Constructor helps e-commerce businesses connect shoppers with the products they want through AI-powered search and product discovery. We’re looking for an experienced Retail Media sales professional to help grow our business across EMEA. You’ll work with retailers to understand their monetisation ambitions, build compelling business cases and sell technology that helps them develop and scale their Retail Media offering. This is a hands-on commercial role—not a campaign-operations position. You’ll combine deep industry knowledge with enterprise sales discipline, working alongside Account Managers and the wider Sales team to turn qualified opportunities into lasting customer partnerships. What you’ll do Own Retail Media opportunities from discovery to close Identify and qualify opportunities with retailers looking to launch, improve or scale their Retail Media business. Lead consultative discovery with Retail Media, e-commerce, commercial and technology stakeholders. Build opportunity strategies with clear decision processes, executive engagement and agreed next steps. Lead proposals, negotiations and commercial agreements in partnership with the relevant account owner. Maintain a credible pipeline and an evidence-based forecast.
